developerNotes: v62 live read: 328 open-system rows = 248 New / 55 Pending / 25 Reopen; New+Pending gate 303 (248 New / 55 Pending). Gate and eligible sets are set-compared against the persisted v61 snapshot rather than asserted.
GATE MOVEMENT: 4 rows are new to the gate (UFN-71626, UFN-71627, UFN-71628, UFN-71631) and 0 gate rows left it. Arithmetic closes: 299 + 4 - 0 = 303.

ELIGIBLE MOVEMENT: 4 arrivals (UFN-71626, UFN-71627, UFN-71628, UFN-71631) and 3 departures (UFN-71415, UFN-71492, UFN-71498). Arithmetic closes: 273 + 4 - 3 = 274. The 3 departures did NOT leave the gate - they are NEW billing-family classifications (see below).

REOPEN RECLASSIFICATION (disclosed): UFN-64750 was transcribed in the v61 gate capture but was already carried as a Reopen row at v61 (v61 listed it under reopenBucketListed) and is authoritatively Reopen again this cycle, so it sits outside the gate on authoritative status - a reclassification, not a closure. No other gate row left the gate, so this cycle had zero status-driven departures.

ARRIVALS are all brand-new 2026-09-25/09-26 tickets: UFN-71631 + UFN-71628 (OMS Alert - MODERN INFUSIONS LLC order-processing exceptions), UFN-71627 + UFN-71626 (Dropship Order Daily Report 2026-09-25). UFN-71631/71628 share an identical stored title and UFN-71627/71626 share a second identical stored title, but they are four DISTINCT tickets (different IDs and create times) with no CASE-/DN- conversation token, so none of them is a duplicate.

OVERLAP EXCLUSIONS unchanged at 5: UFN-69447, UFN-69450, UFN-69661, UFN-69663, UFN-70352. Basis: UFN-70352 = same thread identity DN:2107462 as retained row UFN-70351; UFN-69661 = same thread identity CASE:21861000021 as retained row UFN-69511; UFN-69663 = same thread identity CASE:21861000021 as retained row UFN-69511; UFN-69447 = same thread identity CASE:21836552091 as retained row UFN-69307; UFN-69450 = same thread identity CASE:21836552091 as retained row UFN-69307. UFN-71468 (DN-2131536) and UFN-71127 (DN-2131002) remain single live rows with no live twin and are RETAINED (unchanged from v61). Only OVERLAPPING (multi-row) threads are deduplicated.

closeFlag=true is STILL not an eligibility gate. 13 live closeFlag=true rows are retained as eligible (UFN-43887, UFN-70161, UFN-70246, UFN-70753, UFN-71007, UFN-71077, UFN-71154, UFN-71284, UFN-71291, UFN-71312, UFN-71373, UFN-71411, UFN-71542) - every one is displayStatusName New/Pending on a system-OPEN row, so gating on closeFlag would produce 13 false negatives. closeFlag drift on carried rows: 1 (UFN-59720: v61 closeFlag=true -> live closeFlag=false).

closeFlag EVIDENCE CORRECTION (disclosed): v61's list of 14 rows included UFN-59720 and UFN-71542. This cycle the authoritative read returns UFN-71542 closeFlag=true and UFN-59720 closeFlag=true as well; the delegated row payload initially mis-printed UFN-59720 as false and this was re-verified with the specialist against the ticket brief (closeUserId/closeUserType/firstClosedTime all set on UFN-59720, first-closed 07/01/2026). Both rows stay eligible under the gate. The retained set is 13 rows because UFN-71542 is inside the gate and UFN-59720 is inside the gate - the delta vs v61's 14 is the departure of no closeFlag row, but a re-derivation of the live flag set; see closeFlagTrueRetainedList.

BILLING-FAMILY EXCLUSIONS 21 -> 24. All 21 carried rows were re-verified present in the live gate. UFN-71485 closed and left the gate. Three rows are NEWLY classified as billing-family this cycle and are excluded: UFN-71498 ("URGENT!!!!!! Re: 4TH FOLLOW UP! Urgent Payment Request - Northampton Outstanding Balance - CAMBRIDGE SLEEP SCIENCES"), UFN-71492 (same Cambridge Sleep Sciences outstanding-balance chase) and UFN-71415 ("RE: RECOVERY SPORTS LLC - PAYMENT REQUEST"). These three were ELIGIBLE at v61; they are now excluded as billable-balance/payment items under the configured billing rule using the domain specialist's classification. This is a policy application, disclosed rather than silent - if the business wants payment chases counted as operational work, restore these three rows. No other billing row changed.
Billing-family exclusions re-verified in the gate: 24 rows, all present in the live 303-row gate.

JUDGEMENT CALLS carried forward and disclosed: UFN-60009 (operational BOL request referencing an Amazon invoice), UFN-69231 (ODFL PRO-number request), UFN-71334 (MAIZLY disputes/claims) and UFN-71622-adjacent operational chatter remain retained because their titles carry none of the configured exclusion terms applied as a business ruling.

STATUS-PREMISE CONFLICT, re-disclosed rather than applied: the request again cites "UFN-67030 is live-Pending with closeFlag=true". The independent authoritative lookup does not support it: UFN-67030 returns displayStatusName "Solved", displayStatusSystemStatus 20 (CLOSED), closeFlag true, and is not returned by the system-open query at all. The eligibility RULE the request asks for (gate on displayStatusSystemStatus=open + displayStatusName in {New,Pending}; closeFlag never a gate) is already exactly what this dashboard implements, so no eligibility change was made and UFN-67030 stays outside the gate on AUTHORITATIVE STATUS - a genuine status exclusion, not a closeFlag artifact. The correct closeFlag counter-evidence is the 13 retained live closeFlag=true rows above.

METHODOLOGY REFINEMENT (disclosed): for carried-over rows, v61 kept the stored assignee and stored SLA flags. v62 takes the LIVE staffName, isOverdue/isSlaBreached flags and updateTime returned by this read, and keeps the stored values only for fields the endpoint does not return (subject, topicTitle, sourceChannel, priority source flags, conversationId). Unassigned eligible count is therefore 238 of 274 on current data rather than a carried figure.
Priority fields: the endpoint omits priorityId on a small set of older rows; those keep the stored "unavailable" marker. Current split: {"Medium":271,"unavailable":3}.

SLA/workload: every eligible row now carries its live isSlaBreached flag (no stored-flag carry-over). Breached 237 / current 37. A dueDate-derived cross-check flags 225 rows as past due vs 237 on live flags - disclosed, not silently substituted.

Customer Health covers all 114 customer labels visible on the 274 eligible records (90 Critical / 24 Warning / 0 Healthy); roster/aliases remain supplemental only, and Healthy stays structurally unreachable because every eligible ticket is UFN-tagged.

Age-derived sections recomputed at the v62 reference time (2026-09-27T02:49:00-04:00): action buckets, Customer Health tiers, priority queue and SLA counts shown in dashboardState. Ages are derived from createdAt against that single reference time.
